free_tier.stated: USD 15 of free credits per month for every organization, usable across services; the rate for the macOS machine is USD 0.09 per minute on a 4-vCPU machine, which is about 166 macOS minutes a month at that rate
free_tier.notes: Derived: USD 15 / USD 0.09 per minute = 166.7 macOS minutes. The USD 15 credit is a monthly dollar allowance, not a macOS-specific minute pool.

per_object_cap.stated: an artifact size cap is not stated on the pricing page; the job time limit is 1 hour by default and at most 24 hours
per_object_cap.notes: The job clock, not a byte cap, is the published per-job bound.

retention.stated: workflow and job artifacts have a maximum retention of 400 days

egress.terms: 20 GB of artifact egress and 100 GB of artifact storage a month are free; further egress is USD 0.35 per GB and further storage USD 0.07 per GB
egress.free_allowance: 20 GB a month of artifact egress
egress.price_per_tb: USD 350 per TB beyond the monthly allowance, from USD 0.35 per GB

interface_detail: a pipeline YAML in a Git repository with the visual workflow editor; the sem CLI opens an SSH session into a running job
tooling: macOS Xcode images on A2 machines; pipeline YAML, the visual workflow editor and the sem CLI
chaining: a hosted macOS build stage for a repository; a USD 15 monthly credit is shared with Linux and ARM machines, and artifacts leave free up to 20 GB a month

limits.value: USD 15 of credit a month; at the macOS rate of USD 0.09 a minute that is about 166 minutes on a 4-vCPU A2 machine

binding_note: The USD 15 monthly credit is spent after about 166 macOS minutes, before the 20 concurrent jobs or 20 GB egress allowance bind.

identity_cost.detail: Sign-up uses a GitHub, Bitbucket or GitLab account; the pricing page links Start free to the signup page and states no card is required for the start-free offer.

reliability_note: the job agent is ephemeral; a 1-hour default job limit terminates longer jobs and a shared runner address can already be rate-limited by Docker Hub
confidence_note: The A2 macOS rate, monthly credit, concurrency, artifact egress, retention and sign-up options were read and quoted on 2026-11-24; the minute conversion is arithmetic over quoted rates.
